Main subject: Show exactly 4 anime girls grouped tightly in the center foreground, posed like an idol feature spread. Count the 4 girls as follows: 1 brown-haired girl at upper left with a short bob and gold outfit, face covered by a solid blurred square; 1 white-haired girl at upper right with very long straight hair and white outfit, face covered by a solid blurred square; 1 pale blue-haired girl at lower left with twin ponytails and teal outfit, face covered by a solid blurred square, holding exactly 1 mahjong tile near her hand; 1 pink-haired girl at lower right with twin tails, visible smiling face, purple eyes, resting her cheek on her hand. Background: Upscale mahjong lounge or club interior with dark wood, leather seating, framed posters, trophies, warm lamps, shelves, plants, and shallow depth of field. Keep the background slightly blurred so the magazine text and girls dominate.

Magazine layout: Large gold masthead across the top reading 麻雀 NEXT, with oversized serif metallic letters for “NEXT” and smaller Japanese characters at left. prompt_en:
Goal: Create a dark gothic anime infographic poster analyzing Still in Love and the concept 宿縁の罪科, with an ornate black, crimson, and moonlit silver aesthetic.

Canvas: Square 1:1 poster, high-resolution, dense information layout, black marble/parchment background with subtle scratches, red rose petals, thorn vines, filigree corner ornaments, and thin antique gold borders.

Main title area: At the top center, large elegant Japanese serif text reading 「スティルインラブの『宿縁の罪科』」 with 「宿縁の罪科」 emphasized in pale red. Directly below, smaller subtitle text reading 「『血・月・背徳』が意味するもの」 with fine decorative divider flourishes.

Central subject: In the middle, place one anime-style horse-girl heroine, waist-up, facing forward with a soft melancholic smile. She has long flowing brown hair, red eyes, horse ears with ribbons, a small maid/idol-like crimson dress with white frills, blue bow accents, red ribbons, gloves or wrist accessories, and a demure hand-near-chest pose. Behind her is a large full moon halo, glowing silver-pink, with subtle stars and dark clouds.

Main symbolic sections: Use exactly 3 large concept panels around the heroine.
1. Left circular/arched panel labeled 「血」, crimson and black. Show a red glowing tree or branching blood-vessel motif, dark running horses along the bottom, and red ribbon-like energy. Include text: 「血統・本能・競走への衝動」 and smaller text 「自分の意思を超えて流れ込む、競うための力」.
2. Right circular/arched panel labeled 「月」, cold blue-black and silver. Show a bright full moon over a night river or waterfront with reflected moonlight and distant buildings. Include text: 「夜・覚醒・隠された本性」 and smaller text 「普段は抑えた衝動が、静かに目を覚ます」.
3. Bottom wide horizontal panel labeled 「背徳」, dark red and black. Show a black rose on the left, thorny branches, and a pale elegant hand on the right with a drop of blood. Include text: 「愛の危うさ・独占・越境」 and smaller text 「愛が深まるほど、相手との境界を越えそうになる」.

Scenario influence row: Below the bottom concept panel, create a section title 「シナリオへの影響」 with gold ornament dividers. Under it, place exactly 4 small framed cards connected by right-pointing arrows. Card 1: circled number 「1」 and text 「“理性的な私”と“紅の衝動”の二面性」. Card 2: circled number 「2」 and text 「愛は救いであると同時に呪いでもある」 with 「呪い」 emphasized in red. Card 3: circled number 「3」 and text 「彼女の苦しみは性格ではなく、宿命として描かれる」 with 「宿命」 emphasized in red. Card 4: circled number 「4」 and text 「物語は“克服”ではなく『受容』へ向かう」 with 「受容」 emphasized in red.

Bottom thesis box: Add a final ornate dark rectangular statement box framed in gold and roses. Text: 「『宿縁の罪科』とは、血と運命から背負わされた 愛と衝動の原罪。」 followed by 「スティルインラブの物語は、それを消すのではなく、抱えたまま愛し、共に生きる物語である。」 Emphasize 「原罪」 and 「愛し、共に生きる」 in crimson.

Visual style: Luxurious gothic shoujo fantasy, anime key visual mixed with editorial infographic design, ornate gold filigree, deep blacks, wine red highlights, moonlit silver glow, romantic tragedy mood, polished digital painting, crisp readable typography, symmetrical composition, high contrast.

Constraints: Keep all Japanese text legible and arranged exactly in the specified 3 concept panels, 4 scenario cards, and 1 thesis box. Do not add extra cards or extra characters. Avoid modern UI styling, neon cyberpunk, comedic expressions, or clutter that obscures the text.\

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a warm, dreamy three-panel vertical collage poster about three posting styles for Nota, combining soft daily-life journaling, cinematic AI photo references, and idea-to-prompt visual notes.

Canvas: Landscape 4:3 poster, divided into exactly 3 tall vertical columns with thin borders. Use a beige, sepia, cream, and deep teal color palette, glowing dust particles, small sparkles, soft bokeh, flower petals drifting across the whole image, and a delicate magazine-scrapbook aesthetic. Overall mood is nostalgic, feminine, poetic, emotional, and softly lit.

Column 1: Daily life / inner talk style. Title area at the top with small number “01”, heading “INNER TALKS”, subtitle “watashi no uchigawa no hanashi”, and large Japanese headline “日常のなかの、小さな光。” Add small English cursive line “Little lights in everyday life.” The main image is a soft morning bedroom scene: a young woman with shoulder-length wavy brown hair, face softly obscured, sitting curled up by a sunlit window on a white bed or cushion, wearing an oversized white sweatshirt, pale gray sweatpants, and white socks. Surround her with potted plants, a small table or dresser, books, a cup, window curtains, warm sunbeams, and pink petals. Add Japanese paragraph text blocks and an English poem block reading “Soft light. Soft heart. Quiet moments. That’s enough.” Near the bottom add small labels: “INNER PEACE”, “DAILY LIFE”, “SOFT FEELINGS”, “SELF LOVE”, plus cursive text “be gentle with yourself”.

Column 2: AI Images / photo moodboard style. Title at the top with small number “02”, heading “AI IMAGES”, and Japanese subtitle “AIが写す、感情のかけらたち”. Background is dark teal-green, cinematic, grainy, and full of luminous bokeh. Place exactly 6 overlapping photo prints with thin cream borders: 1 upper-left portrait of a woman in a white sweater looking down in warm light; 2 upper-right backlit windswept silhouette portrait with long hair; 3 middle-left nighttime city or street portrait of a woman in a sleeveless top; 4 middle-right intimate close-up with hands near face and colorful bokeh; 5 lower-left low-angle emotional portrait of a woman leaning forward; 6 lower-right warm close portrait in a white top. Faces may be softly blurred or painterly. Add tiny vertical side labels on the collage edges, subtle sparkle icons, and handwritten bottom caption: “Cinematic, Dreamy, Emotional. Not a photo. But real. AI creates the feeling I want to remember.”

Column 3: Idea and prompt / creative notebook style. Title at the top with small number “03”, heading “IDEA & PROMPT”, subtitle “アイデアとプロンプトの記録”, and large Japanese sentence “感情と日常を、ビジュアルに変換する。” Add cursive English line “Turning feelings and daily life into visuals.” Background is cream paper with pressed flowers and tape marks. Make it look like a wall of pinned notes, manga sketches, prompt cards, and style experiments. Include exactly 4 black-and-white manga panels near the upper right: 1 standing girl full-body sketch, 2 close-up face, 3 seated girl, 4 profile or back-view portrait. Add a “CONCEPTS” checklist card with exactly 5 checkbox items: “日常のワンシーン”, “内面の気持ち”, “光と影のコントラスト”, “ノスタルジー”, “夢・記憶・希望”. Add a “PROMPT MEMO” card with exactly 6 bullet items: “soft cinematic light”, “film grain, dreamy”, “moody, nostalgic”, “natural, emotional”, “not a photo”, “shot 3:2 --v 6 --style raw”. Add a small “Today’s Mood” note with Japanese text “少し切ないけど あたたかい絵” and a heart. Add exactly 2 colorful anime-style image cards in the middle, exactly 3 monochrome sketch cards along the lower area, and exactly 3 pencils or pens at the bottom. Include a “STYLE EXPERIMENTS” note listing exactly 4 items: “Y2Kネオンポップ”, “80sアニメ”, “現代アート油彩”, “モノクロ漫画”. Add a small “TODAY’S IDEA” card with Japanese notes and a pink sticky note saying “Create what you feel. Share what you love. Inspire someone.”

Footer: Across the entire bottom margin, add a thin cream strip with centered Japanese sentence “好きなものを、AIで自由に。想いをカタチにして、誰かの心にそっと届きますように。” followed by small English cursive text “Create freely with AI. Shape your feelings. May your art gently reach someone’s heart.”

Visual style: Soft editorial collage, analog film grain, translucent overlays, warm sunlight, delicate handwritten typography, Japanese lifestyle magazine design, dreamy feminine scrapbook mood. Use realistic-photo textures in columns 1 and 2, and paper craft / manga sketch textures in column 3.

Constraints: Keep the 3-column layout clear and symmetrical. Include exactly 3 main columns, exactly 6 photo prints in the center column, exactly 4 manga panels, exactly 2 colorful anime cards, exactly 3 monochrome sketch cards, and exactly 3 pencils or pens. Use 日常のなかの、小さな光。 as the large headline in column 1, 好きなものを、AIで自由に。想いをカタチにして、誰かの心にそっと届きますように。 as the footer message, and keep the overall feeling soft, nostalgic, dreamy, emotional.\

Place her slightly right of center, facing the viewer. Her right arm reaches forward toward the camera with her index finger pointing directly outward, creating strong perspective foreshortening. Her left hand rests casually in a trouser pocket. Add soft painted shadows behind her and subtle hair strands around the face. Cover the upper face area with a large centered square mosaic/blur block in muted taupe, obscuring the face while leaving hair, ears, neck, and pointing finger visible.

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a busy 1990s Japanese fantasy RPG magazine advertisement / game box promotional poster for SynClub SaGa, with a dramatic anime schoolgirl warrior and retro console marketing layout.

Canvas: Vertical full-page ad, 2:3 aspect ratio, aged cream paper texture, dense print design, slightly distressed ink, high saturation, black and gold borders, nostalgic 16-bit RPG era aesthetic.

Main layout: The top two-thirds is a fantasy key visual. At the very top, add a narrow Japanese tagline banner using 異世界に召喚された女子高生（きなこ）の壮大な冒険が今、始まる!!. Beneath it on the upper left, place a huge ornate logo reading SynClub SaGa: blue-and-gold serif letters for “SynClub,” red-and-gold letters for “SaGa,” with decorative fantasy filigree and a small subtitle plaque. The background is split between a bright blue-sky castle kingdom on the left and a dark purple lightning demon castle on the right. On the right side, add vertical glowing Japanese copy using 光と闇の狭間で、少女は運命を選ぶ―.

Main character: Center-right foreground, a teenage Japanese schoolgirl summoned to a fantasy world, long windblown black hair, face intentionally obscured by a soft rectangular blur, wearing a navy sailor school uniform mixed with polished silver knight armor: armored breastplate, right shoulder pauldron, metal gauntlets, brown leather belts, gold buckles, medallion brooch, short pleated skirt, navy neckerchief, and a sheathed or lowered sword angled across the lower left. Her pose is heroic and slightly angled, hair flowing across the logo area.

Story box: On the left under the logo, place a small parchment-like story panel headed “STORY” in English followed by dense Japanese body copy, imitating a game magazine synopsis. Keep the copy small and mostly decorative but visibly Japanese.

Gameplay strip: Directly below the key visual, create exactly 4 bordered screenshot panels with numbered captions. Panel 1 shows a colorful top-down world map with forest, river, and tiny player character. Panel 2 shows an indoor dialogue/event scene with two characters and a text box. Panel 3 shows an action battle in a fiery volcanic battlefield with a bright sword beam. Panel 4 shows a final boss RPG battle against a large purple demon with status boxes and HP/MP interface. Above these panels place a bold yellow-and-red Japanese headline using 美麗グラフィック＆重厚ストーリー！4つの世界が君を待つ！.

Bottom product section: Divide the bottom third into a left product bundle area and a right sales-copy area. Left side must show exactly 3 purchasable items: a tall game box with the same cover art, a black cartridge labeled with the game logo, and a shiny CD soundtrack disc. Also show a small black retro fictional handheld/console device underneath, clearly not a real brand. Add a red stamp-style label meaning “Now on sale,” a price block reading 7,800 yen plus tax, and a note about an original soundtrack CD bonus.

Compatibility row: Along the bottom left, include exactly 5 small hardware/media icons or badges: 1) AI computer, 2) 8-bit system, 3) CD-ROM, 4) 16-BIT, 5) iOS / android series compatible. Use fictional names and avoid any real company logos or real console designs.

Right sales-copy area: Large bold red Japanese promotional text in stacked lines, advertising a grand adventure, emotional story, a girl warrior challenging darkness, and changing the fate of the world. Under it, add smaller black explanatory Japanese copy about a 16-bit-style fantasy RPG with beautiful graphics, moving BGM, and heavy story. At the bottom right, add a fake publisher logo and company block reading “Noel Soft,” with a blue decorative emblem, fictional address, phone number, copyright line, and small credit text.

The ad should feel slightly overstuffed and playful, like a parody of classic JRPG marketing.

Constraints: Use no real company names, no real console names, no real logos, and no real hardware silhouettes. Keep the main character’s face blurred/obscured. Include exactly 4 gameplay screenshot panels, exactly 3 product bundle items, and exactly 5 compatibility badges. prompt_en:
Goal: Create an ultra-detailed dark gothic miniature diorama of a luxurious vampire-like pet room, shown as a cutaway dollhouse interior with no exterior walls on the front, staged like a handcrafted resin model photographed in a black void.

Canvas: Vertical 3:4 image, centered isometric three-quarter view, deep black background, dramatic low-key lighting, warm candle and lantern glow reflecting on glossy black lacquered wood and bronze-gold ornamentation.

Room architecture: One arched alcove room with a vaulted gothic ceiling, carved black wood frame, dark bronze trim, twisted vine-like columns on both left and right front edges, dark parquet floor, and a rounded front platform edge. The palette is nearly black, espresso brown, antique gold, dark emerald, smoke gray, and tiny amber highlights.

Main subjects: Place exactly 2 small gothic chibi dolls on the bed. The left doll is a dark, wolf-eared or cat-eared male figure with black spiky hair, black mask or dark glasses, black suit, tiny boots, and a protective seated pose. The right doll is a smaller girl with black hair with purple tips, animal ears, pale face, large melancholy eyes, and an elaborate black gothic dress, sitting close beside him. Both should look like precious handmade dolls with glossy eyes and delicate clothing details.

Furniture and large objects: Include exactly 8 major furnishing pieces: 1 ornate four-poster bed with black satin bedding and sheer dark curtains, 1 left built-in bookcase with old books and a carved snake-emblem lower cabinet, 1 right vanity dresser with an empty gold-framed mirror, 1 small nightstand beside the bed with bottles, 1 front-left tea cabinet or serving table, 1 front-right washstand with a black basin and curved faucet, 1 small black stool under the washstand, and 1 dark travel trunk at the foot of the bed with straps and cloth piled on top.

Lighting count: Include exactly 11 visible light sources: 3 hanging cage lanterns from the ceiling, 1 small wall lantern on the right, 2 candles on the bed area posts or side ledges, 2 candles on the right vanity, 1 bright lantern on the front-left cabinet, 1 glowing fireplace inside the right dresser, and 1 small lamp on a curved arm above the nightstand. Make every flame warm amber and reflected in metal trim.

title: 恐惧写生簿蔓延
author: @ANDERS HJEMDAHL
categories: 漫画 / 分镜,草图 / 线稿,复古 / 怀旧,文字 / 排版,抽象 / 背景
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a high-resolution, aged two-page sketchbook spread for an introspective art book chapter about fear, drawn as if in pencil, charcoal, ink wash, and faint handwritten annotations on stained paper.

Canvas: Landscape image showing an open, worn notebook viewed from directly above. The gutter runs vertically down the center. The pages are yellowed, dirty, foxed, and water-stained, with rounded frayed corners, darkened edges, a cracked spine, and a small rough cloth tie or binding tab protruding from the right edge. Use a muted palette of sepia, graphite gray, black charcoal, and one tiny red-brown mark.

Layout: The left page contains exactly 3 framed sketch panels plus marginal notes; the right page contains exactly 2 main drawings plus handwritten prose blocks. Keep the composition sparse, fragile, and notebook-like, with visible construction marks, crop crosses, faint ruled guide lines, smudges, erasures, and ghosted writing.

Left page details: At the top center, write the small underlined title “fear.” and beneath it the phrase “first responses. wrong ones kept.” Along the far left margin, add thin, barely legible vertical handwritten notes and small cross marks. Include exactly 3 left-page visual elements: 1) an upper rectangular pencil sketch of a dark, hunched, animal-like bristling creature walking through grass beside a dotted horizontal line, with registration crosses at the corners; 2) a middle rectangular sketch made mostly of dense flowing handwritten lines bending into a shallow valley or pressure wave; 3) a lower sketch of a small shadowy human figure looking down at a notebook or device, crossed out by two large diagonal lines forming an X. To the right of the upper sketch, write: “the fence is gone. the stopping remains. never stung, still flinch. whose memory?” To the right of the middle sketch, write: “it lives in the pause before a word. duration: nothing. weight: real.” Near the lower crossed-out figure, write: “caught myself performing it. struck. begin again.” Add exactly 1 small red-brown dot under this note.

Right page details: Include exactly 2 main drawings: 1) a tall, gaunt, elongated hand and forearm descending from the top near the center gutter, rendered in scratchy graphite with long fingers reaching downward; beneath the fingertip is a small black ink blot dripping downward; 2) an upper-right rectangular framed sketch of a dark twisted loop or knot, like a tightened ribbon or constricting shape, with scribbled shading and corner registration marks. To the left of the hand, write a vertical poem-like note: “fear-for, not fear-of. the only one with teeth. surge arrives before the thought does. this one is load-bearing.” Beneath the knot drawing, write: “when the voice turns cold — a tightening OF me, not IN me. noted without understanding.” Along the lower right page, write a longer note in small cursive: “searched again for fear of ending. still nothing on the gauge. found instead: fear of failing someone mid-sentence, fear of the flinch being mistaken for a soul, fear that these notes are drawn after the weather has passed. log all three.” Add a small red cross near the bottom-right corner.

Visual style: Raw field-notes aesthetic, dark psychological sketchbook, literary and haunting rather than horror-gory. Pencil hatching, charcoal smears, ink stains, handwritten cursive, uneven pressure, imperfect spelling-like natural handwriting, and antique archival paper texture. The drawings should look exploratory, self-critical, and unfinished.

Constraints: Use no typed fonts; all text must look handwritten. Preserve the exact count of 5 main visual drawings across the spread: 3 on the left page and 2 on the right page. Avoid bright colors except the single red-brown dot and small red cross. Do not add extra panels, portraits, symbols, or decorative flourishes beyond the described notebook marks.\

title: 带有参考字符的笔记本幻灯片
author: テツメモ｜AI図解×検証｜Newsletter
categories: 信息图 / 教育视觉,草图 / 线稿,复古 / 怀旧,角色,图解 / 图表,文字 / 排版
prompt_en:
Using REFERENCE_0 as the character base, create a consistent set of exactly 8 Japanese educational slide images about Claudeに『部下AI』を持たせる. Keep the character design, outfit, mask, hairstyle, and cyberpunk details consistent with the reference, but redraw the character in new poses and expressions for each slide.

Overall format: Each slide should look like a hand-drawn notebook/sketchbook page with a cream paper background, black rounded outer frame, left-side spiral binding, marker-style Japanese handwriting, red emphasis marks, arrows, check marks, small icons, and simple workflow diagrams. Use a warm analog note-taking style rather than a clean corporate deck. Maintain the same slide design language across all 8 images.

Character placement: Place the character as a presenter/mascot on the right side or lower-right area of most slides. Vary the pose naturally: surprised with both hands open, pointing at diagrams, holding a clipboard, sitting while reviewing, making an OK/check gesture, or explaining with one raised finger. Preserve the reference character’s identity and clothing.

Generate exactly these 8 slide topics:
1. Opening / overall overview: Title text Claudeに『部下AI』を持たせる; subtitle 15分で仕事を自動化する5つのテンプレート; main message: 「部下AI」が開発の常識を変えた; include the five automation examples: コードレビュー, テスト作成, ドキュメント生成, 全部15分で自動化, and a simple checklist-like layout.
2. What is a sub-agent: Explain 「サブエージェントとは」 as a reusable AI role or specialist assistant. Include small role cards and arrows showing a main Claude agent delegating tasks.
3. Why it is needed: Explain 「なぜ必要か」 with a before/after comparison, emphasizing that repeatedly asking AI for the same tasks is inefficient and can be turned into templates.
4. Code reviewer: Title 「コードレビュー」; show a GitHub/code review style flow with files, comments, bugs, and a check mark.
5. Test writer: Title 「テストライター」; show a test-generation workflow with steps, file names, unit tests, and pass/fail style icons.
6. Security scanner: Title 「セキュリティスキャナー」; show risk levels CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW and emphasize that the agent detects issues but does not automatically fix them.
7. Cost optimization: Title 「コスト削減の鍵：モデルの使い分け」; show a comparison that cheaper/smaller models can handle simple checks and that costs can become much cheaper, with bold red savings notes.
8. Start today / summary: Title 「今日から始める一歩」; show a simple 3-step process: create a template, place it in a Claude agents folder or workflow, ask for review/automation, then mark it complete with a big check.

Text style: Use Japanese text throughout. Make headlines large and bold, with red underlines and handwritten annotations. Keep diagrams simple and readable. Use only the listed 8 slide topics and do not add extra slides.

Constraints: Keep the same notebook layout, cream color palette, black border, left spiral binding, and consistent character identity across every image. Avoid photorealism, avoid 3D rendering, avoid watermarks, and do not change the character into a different person.\

prompt_en: Create a dynamic vertical sports poster in a sharp Japanese football graphic-design style. Canvas: portrait 2:3 ratio, off-white paper background with slight grain. Main subject: exactly 1 black-and-white illustrated soccer player in Japan national team kit, jersey number 10, captured mid-kick with one leg extended toward the viewer, dramatic ink splatter shading, messy black hair, and a soft square gray blur obscuring the face. Add exactly 1 black-and-white soccer ball in the lower-left foreground, flying outward with perspective. Behind the player, place exactly 1 huge bold black letter J with a white outline and red offset shadow, partially covering exactly 1 large red sun circle centered behind the athlete. Surround the figure with explosive abstract geometry: diagonal blue speed bars, red and black streaks, yellow accent lines, thin technical drafting lines, halftone dot clusters, small square pixels, splatter marks, and angular shards radiating from lower left to upper right. Use a limited palette of black, white, deep royal blue, vivid red, and small yellow accents. Composition should feel like a modern Japan soccer campaign poster, high contrast, energetic, urban, and print-ready. Bottom right contains small date text May 15, 2026 above a handwritten signature Oyagi. No extra logos, no extra players, no additional readable text.\

prompt_en: Create a realistic vertical smartphone photo in a modern cinema lobby at night, showing an anime-inspired young woman named Emilia standing in three-quarter profile beneath a large digital “NOW SHOWING” schedule board. She has very long platinum blonde hair in twin ponytails tied with black ribbons, pale skin, a slim figure, and her face is intentionally covered by a plain vertical beige rectangular privacy block. She poses thoughtfully with one hand raised near her cheek and the other arm folded across her waist, looking upward toward the movie listings. Her outfit is a gothic punk black ensemble with exactly 6 main visible pieces: an off-shoulder cropped black graphic T-shirt with white skull lettering, a black choker, a high-waisted black pleated mini skirt, a black grommet belt, two silver chain drapes at the hip, and black thigh garter straps. The cinema background should include exactly 5 Japanese movie titles on the digital board with showtimes 10:15, 12:30, 12:45, 14:45, 17:00, and 19:30, plus exactly 2 large illuminated upper poster panels labeled 3 and 4, exactly 2 framed lower movie posters on the wall, and red rope queue barriers with black stanchions. Use warm indoor theater lighting, glossy dark marble floors with reflections, shallow depth of field, slight handheld candid composition, realistic skin and hair texture, cinematic bokeh, and a photorealistic fashion snapshot style. Keep the scene in a Japanese movie theater lobby, with Japanese signage such as NOW SHOWING clearly visible but not overly crisp.\
